title: 暖灯内角小停顿
description: 油画笔触中，浅内角低位停顿显得平静，完整软垫环绕墙角。

art_direction.medium: linocut print with indigo shadows and ochre highlights
art_direction.scene: Create an original oil-painting illustration of a fictional adult pausing on a low route inside a shallow gym corner under warm evening lights. Both hands rest on broad blue jugs, both shoes occupy generous footholds across the two faces, and the body remains upright in a comfortable stance. The adult calmly looks toward the next nearby hold. Use a wide three-quarter camera with the whole opaque-clothed figure, adjoining walls, and uninterrupted crash mats wrapping into the corner. Rich ochre illumination, blue-gray shadows, and visible impasto create a peaceful original image. Keep proportions plausible and the landing clear. No text, brands, leaps, dangerous height, or forced flexibility.
